propuesta.prompt: @image1 is a real photo of grilled octopus with prawns and boiled potatoes at a restaurant. Use it only as the list of elements, not as a layout to copy. The new photograph must contain the same real elements: curled grilled octopus tentacle with charred suckers, paprika and herb oil; peeled cooked prawns with tails dusted with paprika; sliced boiled yellow potatoes glistening with oil and paprika; drizzled green chopped parsley oil and sprinkled red paprika; round grooved light wooden serving board. Exactly 1 × curled grilled octopus tentacle with charred suckers, paprika and herb oil; 3 × peeled cooked prawns with tails dusted with paprika; 1 × round grooved light wooden serving board. Nothing else added. New composition by a professional food photographer: slightly high three-quarter angle rotated 45 degrees so the entire wooden board sits fully inside the frame with generous margin on the left and top, 50 mm lens at f/5.6, Dish placed in the lower-right half with the whole wooden board uncut, angled so the curled tentacle leads the eye toward a wide clean empty zone on the left for vertical typography, on a clean, plain, uniform background with even light around the whole dish, so it can be cut out cleanly. Bright, even studio light from the upper right casting a crisp, short contact shadow under the board and popping specular highlights on the oil, paprika and octopus suckers, Clean neutral seamless studio backdrop for cutout; warm golden wood, bright yellow potatoes, green herb oil and rich paprika-red octopus as the punchy colours. Overall aesthetic: bright, even studio light with crisp contact shadows; a clean, plain, uniform background that makes the dish easy to cut out; no props: only the dish on its real tableware; saturated, punchy colours; the whole dish inside the frame, not cut by any edge, from a slightly high three-quarter view. Photographic realism, no text. Editorial direction: Leave quiet negative space at the bottom for separate typesetting. Keep the characteristic colours of the ingredients consistent. Render no lettering or graphics.
